tooltip.item.knightlib.great_essence.en: §8§oEven kings become fuel in the end.

tooltip.item.knightlib.small_essence.en: §8§oThe last sigh of a life that changed nothing.
tooltip.item.knightlib.small_essence.zh: §8§o一命呜呼的生命无法改变任何事情。

tooltip.item.knightlib.homunculus.en: §8§oA malformed miracle, bound by alchemy’s price.
tooltip.item.knightlib.homunculus.zh: §8§o一个畸形的奇迹，被炼金术的代价所束缚。

tooltip.item.knightlib.filled_grail.en: §8§oTo drink from it is to dance with death itself.

tooltip.item.knightlib.great_chalice.en: §8§oWhispers names you've never heard... yet somehow remember.
tooltip.item.knightlib.great_chalice.zh: §8§o你从未听闻的名字在耳畔低语...却又似曾相识。
